question:
The following bar graph shows the total number of students in different classes of a school. Read the article carefully and answer the question given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a0a519d93d53c30a18c9ccaa4a85d2ac2acb3e61fc329aa7aada11254d6cc07.png] 

Reference: Number of students, Standard-Classes

The number of students in tenth (Xth) class is what percent less than the number of students in seventh (VIIth) class? (Correct to two decimal places)
solution:
**Calculation:**

The difference between students of Class 10 and 7th is 95 - 60 = 35

The required percentage will be 35/95 × 100 = 36.84 %
